title: AI pixel animations
author: smileinmordor
selftext:
For a while now, I've been trying to create a ComfyUI workflow, which allows generation of pixel art animations.

I am rather aiming for characters (I don't think you can call them sprites at that scale), but i'd love to get to more complicated things such as whole landscapes eventually.

The things is, so far every attempt of mine was a huge miss - regarding both, single frame quality and consistency between them soo... has anyone figured something remotely close to this?

comments.author: ilovebaozi
comments.body: I tried to use wan2.2 with Lora to generate pixel style character animations. From my experience, you’d better use a scale factor bigger than 3 to get better results(for example, if your image is 128*128, your video resolution need to be at least 512)For simple animations like walk or idle, the results are generally good.

replies.author: LittleYo
replies.body: Thing is we need stylized, good looking, anime-like animations, not some crappy walk cycle :|

replies.author: ilovebaozi
replies.body: Talk is cheap. Show some results if you know better ways

replies.author: LittleYo
replies.body: I literally said I need that, not that I have that.
